headline: Pentagon Imposes 45-Day Deadline for Defense Giants to Eliminate Chinese Magnets
summary: America's major weapons manufacturers face a 45-day Pentagon deadline to prove their magnets are free from Chinese rare earth metals dysprosium and terbium.
why: Defense contractors rely on specialized rare earth materials for extreme-temperature military applications, making supply chain restrictions a strategic risk.

impacts.name: US Defense Industry
impacts.why: Defense manufacturers are directly subject to the new Pentagon directive regarding rare earth magnets.
